weightEmpty: Optionally log your weight in Daily check-in to see a trend.
weightNeedTwo: Add another measurement to compare with the previous one.
welcomeIntro: HEALTHMATE helps you track exercise form and daily progress in one place.
workoutBenefits: What you get with each workout
routineIntro: Choose a goal and time budget. Your weekly sessions can adjust as your progress changes.
adherenceBarrier: What makes it harder to keep a routine? (optional)
adaptationMaintain: This plan matches your current preferences. Review your progress to adjust it later.
adaptationSleep: Your recent sleep logs are low, so the plan has fewer sessions and more recovery days.
adaptationForm: Movement accuracy has dipped recently. The plan is lighter for now to prioritize form.
adaptationProgress: Your performance is steady and form is strong, so one session was added gradually.
adaptationBarrierBusy: You selected limited time, so sessions are shorter and the plan is lighter.
adaptationBarrierFatigue: You selected fatigue, so the plan is lighter with extra recovery days.
adaptationBarrierUnclear: The plan is split into short, clear sessions to make it easier to start.
routineAdherence: Workout days in the last week: {active} of {planned}
routineLimit: Trackable exercises: squat, push-up, plank, lunge, glute bridge, wall sit and sit-to-stand. Choose what suits your ability and stop if you feel pain.
detectFormErrors: Spot form errors as you exercise
instantVoiceCues: Get instant voice cues to correct your form
privacyBody: Camera processing stays on your device. We do not save or send photos or video.
dataBody: Your records are stored on your device. If you sign in and agree, they sync to your cloud account. The health assistant (if you turn it on) receives your messages and a small summary only with your consent. You can delete everything from Settings.
safetyBody: This app supports awareness and tracking. It does not replace a doctor or physical therapist. Form feedback is not a diagnosis.
painBody: Stop immediately if you feel pain or dizziness. Consult a professional if symptoms continue.
weightedHint: Dumbbells or two water bottles. The camera counts reps and checks your form, but it does not measure the weight.
poseModelHint: Higher accuracy is more precise but slower, and downloads a large file (about 30MB) the first time, so it needs internet. If your device is slow we switch back to the lighter model automatically.
modelLighter: Your device is slow, switched to a lighter model to keep counting smooth.
lowConfidence: I cannot see your body clearly. Check the lighting (light in front of you, not behind) and keep your whole body in frame.
framingHint: Secure your phone upright on a stand 2–3 m away, around waist height, tilted slightly down. Step back until your head and feet are visible. A side view helps track movement.
squatHint: Use a side view. Move down and up steadily.
pushupHint: Use a side view and keep your full body in frame.
plankHint: Use a side view. Only correct hold time is counted.
cameraConsent: We use the camera to track movement. Processing stays on this device and images are not saved.
unexpectedError: Something unexpected went wrong. Try again; your data on this device is unchanged.
deviceData: From your records on this device
healthDisclaimer: For general tracking only, not a medical assessment or diagnosis.
medicationDisclaimer: Enter medication details as written by your doctor. The app does not suggest or change doses.
dosePlaceholder: Enter the dose exactly as prescribed
noMedicationLog: Add a medication before sharing a log.
noRecentMedicationLog: No doses logged in the last 7 days
medicationSharePrivacy: Shared only when you choose a sharing option.
medAddRequired: Enter the medication name, dose, and times as written in the prescription.
medicationInvalid: Check the stock amount and enter 24-hour times such as 09:00, 21:00.
storageUnavailable: Data could not be saved on this device. Check browser storage and available space.
cloudDataConsent: I agree to sync my workout, health, and medication records to my account. Camera images and video are never synced.
dataSharingDetails: What stays on this device and what is shared
cloudLocalDataDetails: Camera images and video stay on this device and are never saved or synced. Your assistant chat history and assistant summary consent also stay here.
cloudUploadedDataDetails: After you agree, workout sessions, daily check-ins, medication schedules and logs, routine, and app settings are merged with this account. You can revoke future syncing by signing out or clearing app data.
cloudAssistantDataDetails: The optional health assistant is separate: your message is sent to its service only when you submit it. The small health summary is included only with its separate consent.
cloudSetupNeeded: Create a Supabase project, then add its connection details to .env to enable accounts and sync.
cloudCredentialsRequired: Enter your email address and password.
cloudCheckEmail: Check your email to confirm your account, then return and sign in.
cloudAuthFailed: Could not complete that action. Check your sign-in details and project settings.
cloudConsentNeeded: Sign in, then agree to data sync before uploading records.
cloudSyncFailed: Sync failed. Your local data is still on this device; try again.
cloudSignedOut: Signed out. Your progress is still saved on this device and visible in the Progress tab. Sign in again any time to keep syncing.
accountDescription: Keep your health progress and routine in sync across devices after you approve syncing.
accountPrivacyNote: Your health records stay private to your account. Camera images and video are never uploaded.
accountHeroTitle: Health progress that fits your life
accountHeroDescription: Mindful workouts, simple tracking, and small steps guided by your day-to-day progress.
accountHeroPrivacy: Camera analysis stays on your device. Records sync only after you agree.
cloudGoogleSetup: Enable Google as a sign-in provider in Supabase first.
cloudResetSent: If this email is registered, you will receive a password reset link.
cloudAccountMismatch: This device's data is linked to a different account. Choose: load this account's data, or merge this device's data into it.
assistantDisclaimer: For general awareness, not diagnosis or treatment changes. If you have chest pain, shortness of breath, or severe dizziness, seek urgent medical help.
assistantDisabled: The assistant is currently disabled. You can use the rest of the app.
assistantEnabled: The assistant is available. Avoid sharing personal details or sensitive treatment information.
assistantUnavailable: The assistant could not be reached. Please try again later.
assistantWait: Too many requests in a minute. Wait a moment and try again.
cameraDenied: Camera permission is unavailable. Allow camera access in your browser settings and try again.
cameraFailed: Could not open the camera. Check that another app is not using it and that this site uses HTTPS.
modelLoading: Loading the movement model. This may take a moment the first time.
modelFailed: Could not load the movement model. Check your internet connection and try again.
positionPhone: Secure your phone upright 2–3 m away and aim it at your full body. Step back until your head and feet are visible.
noBody: Your body is not in view. Stand in front of the camera.
tooClose: Move back until your head and feet are visible.
cutOff: Part of your body is outside the frame. Adjust your phone.
squatStart: Start squats. Move down and up steadily.
pushupStart: Start push-ups and keep your body straight.
pushupLine: Keep your body in a straight line.
plankPike: Lower your hips to keep your body straight.
greatRep: Great work. That was a strong rep.
greatPushup: Great work. That was a strong push-up.
poorRep: Focus on movement quality on your next rep.
poorPushup: Focus on movement quality on your next push-up.
fatigueFormPrompt: Your form is slipping. Pause and rest if you feel tired.
coachRest: Reduce intensity or take a rest day
coachForm: Focus on form and reduce repetitions
coachMeds: Link reminders to a daily routine
coachImprove: Your progress is steady; increase difficulty gradually
coachContinue: Your routine is going well. Keep it up.
coachStartLog: Log a first session and your sleep to start tracking progress.
reasonSleep: You logged {hours} hours of sleep, below 6 hours.
reasonSleepQuality: You rated your sleep quality {quality} out of 5.
reasonStress: You logged a stress level of {stress} out of 5.
reasonIdle: You have not logged a workout in {days} days. A short session can make it easier to restart.
reasonForm: {rate}% of your repetitions need form work. Reduce the count and focus on movement.
reasonMeds: Logged medication adherence is {rate}%. Link reminders to a daily habit and follow the prescription as written.
reasonImprovement: Your form improved across 3 sessions ({values}). Increase the challenge gradually.
reportDisclaimer: This report is for tracking, not medical diagnosis.
reportCopied: Report copied. You can share it with your doctor or coach.
clearConfirm: Records will be deleted from this device, and from your cloud account too if you're signed in. Continue?
noVoice: Voice coaching is not available in this browser.
refillInvalid: Enter a valid quantity above zero.
remindersOn: Reminders are on. They work while the app is open (even in the background).
remindersBlocked: Reminders are blocked in your browser settings.
remindersUnsupported: This browser does not support notifications.
assistantNeedsSignIn: Sign in from the account icon to use the assistant.
assistantLimit: You reached today's message limit. Try again tomorrow.
assistantSummaryConsent: I agree to send a small summary with my messages to a third party (this week's session count and today's sleep, mood and stress). Weight is never sent.
cloudWipeFailed: We couldn't delete your cloud data, so nothing was deleted on this device. Try again when you're back online.
cloudOffline: You're offline. We'll sync automatically when you're back online.
deleteAccountConfirm: Your account and all your data will be permanently deleted from the cloud and this device. Continue?
deleteAccountFailed: Couldn't delete the account. Please try again.
lungeHint: Step forward and lower with an upright torso. Film from the side.
lungeStart: Start the lunge. Lower and rise slowly
gluteBridgeHint: Lie on your back and lift your hips. Film from the side.
bridgeStart: Lie on your back with knees bent. Lift your hips, pause, then lower
bridgeLift: Lift your hips higher until your body is in a straight line
wallSitHint: Back on the wall, knees at about 90°. Film from the side.
wallSitStart: Back on the wall, slide down until your knees are at 90°, and hold
wallHigh: Slide down until your knees are at 90°
wallLow: Come up a little, you're too low
wallBack: Keep your back on the wall
sitToStandHint: 30-second test: sit and stand as many times as you can. Film from the side.
sitToStandStart: Start standing in front of the chair. Sit and stand as many times as you can in 30 seconds
sideViewHint: Film yourself from the side. Filming from the front makes joint angles inaccurate.
turnSideways: Turn sideways to the camera so angles are measured correctly
timedHint: The session ends automatically after {seconds} seconds.
timedResultNote: The app only records the count and does not interpret it. Share it with your doctor or physiotherapist.
traceCaption: Movement angle over the session (grey lines = rep thresholds). Shown here only, not saved.
repCancelled: Repetition cancelled. Return to the start position.
noArabicVoice: Your device has no Arabic voice, so cues are shown as text.
parqIntro: Quick questions asked once. For awareness only, not a diagnosis.
parqHeart: Has a doctor said you have a heart condition and should only exercise under medical supervision?
parqChestPain: Do you feel pain in your chest when you do physical activity?
parqChestPainRest: In the past month, have you had chest pain when you were not doing physical activity?
parqDizzy: Do you lose your balance because of dizziness, or have you ever lost consciousness?
parqJoint: Do you have a bone or joint problem that could be made worse by physical activity?
parqPressureMeds: Is your doctor currently prescribing medication for blood pressure or a heart condition?
parqOther: Do you know of any other reason you should not do physical activity?
parqConsult: You answered “yes” to one or more questions. We recommend talking to your doctor before you start. You can use easy mode and stop immediately if you feel pain or dizziness.
painStopped: We stopped the session. Pain is a sign to stop.
painAdvice: Rest and don't continue. If the pain persists or returns, talk to your doctor or physiotherapist. If it comes with chest pain, shortness of breath or severe dizziness, get medical help immediately.
backupHint: A backup file contains your health data unencrypted. Keep it somewhere safe.
backupExported: Backup downloaded. Keep it somewhere safe.
backupImported: Backup imported and merged with your data.
backupInvalid: This file is not a valid backup.
backupWrongApp: This file is not from HEALTHMATE.
backupNewer: This backup is from a newer app version. Update the app first.
pushEnable: Enable reminders when the app is closed
pushOn: Background reminders are on: you'll get a notification at dose time even if the app is closed.
pushOff: Background reminders are off. Requires sign-in. The server stores times only, never medication names.
pushNeedsSignIn: Sign in from the account icon first.
pushFailed: Couldn't enable background reminders. Try again.
medNotificationGeneric: It's time for your medication. Check your prescription.
cloudLinkInvalid: This email link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
cloudErrEmailNotConfirmed: Your email isn't confirmed yet. Open the confirmation link we emailed you, then sign in.
cloudErrAlreadyRegistered: This email already has an account. Sign in instead, or reset your password.
cloudErrWeakPassword: That password is too weak. Use at least 8 characters with letters and numbers.
cloudErrRateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
cloudErrSignupDisabled: Email sign-up is disabled in the Supabase project (Authentication → Sign In / Providers → Email).
cloudErrPermission: The server denied access to your data (row-level security). Run supabase/schema.sql in the SQL Editor and sign in again.
cloudErrSchema: The cloud table is missing or outdated. Run supabase/schema.sql in the Supabase SQL Editor.
cloudErrSession: Your session expired or the project key is wrong. Sign in again; if it persists, check VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.
cloudErrNetwork: Couldn't reach Supabase. Check your connection and the project URL.
assistantMisconfigured: The assistant is not set up correctly on the server. Please try again later.
signOutConfirm: Sign out of your account? Your progress stays saved on this device, and signing back in with the same account brings everything back in sync.
cloudMismatchLoad: Load my account's data from the cloud
cloudMismatchMerge: Merge this device's data into this account
cloudMismatchLoadConfirm: This replaces the data on this device with this account's cloud data. Anything on this device that isn't saved in your account will be removed. Continue?
cloudNeverSynced: Not synced yet. Agree to syncing, then tap "Sync my data".
accountHeroPoint1: Camera-guided home workouts with form feedback
accountHeroPoint2: Medication reminders, even when the app is closed
accountHeroPoint3: Your progress synced across devices, with your consent
onDeviceNote: Video is analyzed on your device only - never saved or sent.
unwellStep3: If the feeling continues or worsens, get help from someone nearby or call your doctor.
feelingTitle: How do you feel after the workout?
feelingUnwellAdvice: Sit down, rest, and drink water; if the feeling continues, talk to your doctor.
winStreak: {n} days in a row - keep going! 🔥
winFirst: First time doing this exercise - nice start! 👏
winDone: Well done! Today's workout is done ✅
